description: Role vocabulary for the Senior AI Engineer rubric: nice-to-have and ML-relevant nodes, the anti-signals that apply, the terms that detect them and the wording used in reasoning, consulting firms, and logistics (home country, office cities, preferred work modes). Numeric values (penalties, bands, bonuses, caps) are in shared/config/scoring.py. module1_jd_rubric combines the two into a JDProfile. See docs/SCORING_DESIGN.md.

anti_signal_concerns.research_only: a research/academic background with little production deployment evidence
anti_signal_concerns.consulting_only: a consulting-services career, where the work content is harder to verify
anti_signal_concerns.langchain_only: recent LLM-wrapper work without earlier ML production evidence
anti_signal_concerns.framework_tutorial: tutorial- or demo-level evidence rather than shipped systems
anti_signal_concerns.title_chasing: several short completed roles rather than sustained ownership
anti_signal_concerns.no_recent_handson: a senior or managerial title with little recent hands-on evidence
anti_signal_concerns.cv_speech_robotics: a vision/speech focus rather than retrieval, ranking or NLP
